parsed.post: LR=0.10 + warmup scored 1.0909 — better than LR=0.10 alone (1.1278) but still worse than LR=0.08 + warmup (1.0749). Warmup clearly stabilizes, but 0.10 remains too hot at depth 4. Discarding. Next: MATRIX_LR=0.06 with warmup 0.05 to bracket the LR optimum from below.
parsed.description: Discard MATRIX_LR=0.10 on warmup (1.0909 > 1.0749). New probe: MATRIX_LR=0.06 with WARMUP_RATIO=0.05, all else at current best, to test whether the LR optimum sits below 0.08.
